question: A path 6 m wide runs around and outside of a rectangular plot of length 10 m and breadth 8 m. The area (in m²) of the path is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f2b3018ac5c8605693c0e2ba140ab5ab5d91f6e1345a3e894b7295fd389f20c.png] 

**Given**

length of rectangle = 10 m

Breadth of rectangle = 8m

Width of the path from each side = 6m

**Formula used**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculation**

Area of outer rectangle EFGH = 22 × 20

⇒ 440 m²

Area of inner rectangle ABCD = 10 × 8

⇒ 80 m²

Area of path = Area of rectangle EFGH - Area of inner rectangle ABCD

⇒ 440 - 80

⇒ 360 m²

**∴ The area of the path is 360 m²**
